capabilities: Opens CSV files in a spreadsheet grid with sticky header and row numbers
Edits cells inline with keyboard navigation and multi-cell selection
Searches, filters and replaces values across the sheet or a single column
Copies and pastes Markdown tables and TSV data
Embeds editable CSV grids inside notes with optional row limits
extras: Author states they are not a programmer and used AI to build the plugin; requires Obsidian 1.6.6 or later and works on desktop and mobile.
motivation: The author wanted to work with CSV files inside Obsidian in a way that feels native to the app without having to leave it.
problem: CSV files in Obsidian open as raw text, so reading and editing them means leaving the app or hand-editing delimiters.

relations.evidence: paste accepts both Markdown tables and TSV from Excel or Google Sheets
paste accepts both Markdown tables and TSV from Excel or Google Sheets

summary: Spreadsheet grid editor for CSV files in Obsidian with inline cell editing, keyboard navigation, live search, and Markdown table copy and paste.
